title.zh: 智慧卡挑战反馈期间防止重复提交
title.en: Prevent repeated SmartCard challenge submissions during feedback

purpose.zh: 修复真实 QA 发现的挑战答案已提交后旧倒计时再次提交并覆盖反馈的问题。
purpose.en: Fix the stale countdown resubmitting an answered challenge question and replacing its feedback during real QA.

zh: 同一挑战会话中的每题只允许一个进行中或成功的提交。
失败请求解除该题锁定，并恢复所选答案的重试能力。
en: Allow one pending or successful submission per question in a challenge session.
Unlock failed requests and allow the selected answer to be retried.

zh: 十二种目标语言的智慧卡限时挑战；普通练习仅恢复网络失败后的可重试选项。
en: Timed SmartCard challenges in twelve target languages; ordinary practice only regains its selected option after a failed request.

zh: 使用同步提交门阻止旧 React 倒计时闭包在六秒反馈期间重新发送同一题。
保留服务端判分、当地日期题组及六秒自动推进，未写入合成学习成绩。
en: Use a synchronous submission gate to stop stale React countdown callbacks from resending a question during the six-second feedback interval.
Keep server grading, local-date question sets and automatic six-second progression; no synthetic learning scores are written.

zh: 回归覆盖请求进行中及成功反馈期间的重复倒计时，以及网络失败后的重试。
执行构建、全仓测试、lint、类型检查、D1 迁移重放、SmartPay5 合约测试、依赖审计和共享站点门禁。
中英文智慧卡页面在 390×844、430×932、820×1180、1180×820、1440×900 实际 Chrome 视口无横向溢出；发布后重测挑战。
en: Regression coverage includes duplicate countdown submissions during pending requests and successful feedback, and retry after failure.
Run build, repository tests, lint, typecheck, D1 migration replay, SmartPay5 contract tests, dependency audit and shared site gates.
Chinese and English SmartCard pages show no horizontal overflow at five required real Chrome viewports; retest the challenge after deployment.

zh: 每日四语言完整验收单独记录；本修复发布记录不代表整日 QA 通过。
计划任务保持跟读关闭，不请求麦克风权限。
en: The complete four-language daily acceptance is reported separately; this fix release does not claim a passing daily QA run.
Scheduled QA leaves repeat-after-me off and does not request microphone permission.

zh: 此修复属于 SmartLingo 学习挑战的站点专属逻辑；不迁移其他网站。
en: This is SmartLingo-specific learning challenge logic; no other site is migrated.

rollback.zh: 回退应用至上一已验证提交，无数据库迁移或账本回写。
rollback.en: Roll back the application to the previous verified commit; no database migration or ledger rewrite is needed.
